# Change request 23 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Edit a note on its page, with a body
- A note now also has a **body**: free text that is empty for every existing note and every newly added note.
- The page of a note that is not archived gets a form with a text input with the accessible label `Title` holding
  the current title, a multi-line text field with the accessible label `Body` holding the current body, and a
  button `Save`. The browser limits the fields: `Title` is `required` with `maxlength="60"`, and `Body` has
  `maxlength="1000"`.
- `Save` checks both fields on the **server** and saves only when both are valid:
  - the title follows the rules of adding: trimmed, 1–60 characters, and not the title of another of the user's notes
    (case-insensitive, archived notes included). The messages are `Write a title first`, `Use at most 60
    characters` and `You already have a note with this title`;
  - the body is trimmed and at most 1000 characters; a longer body gives `Use at most 1000 characters in the body`.
    Line breaks inside the body are kept.
- When anything is invalid, nothing is saved, every message that applies is shown, each in its own element with
  `role="alert"` (a title message and a body message can show together), and both fields keep exactly what the
  user typed.
- After a successful save the page shows the text `Saved` in an element with `role="status"`, the new title in the
  `<h1>`, and the body with its line breaks. The note keeps its number, place in the list, pin and `Added` date.
  A save is a change to the user's notes: it ends an `Undo` message, like `Edit`.
- The page of an archived note shows its body but no form, and the **server** refuses to save an archived note.
- All of this also works with JavaScript disabled.

import { contract, part, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { accountDelete, archive, home, notePage } from '../../routes.ts'
import {
  Add,
  Archive,
  archiveNotes,
  Bulk,
  removeNotes,
  Select,
  listArchived,
  Restore,
  addedOn,
  exportNotes,
  CancelEdit,
  Edit,
  Save,
  Draft,
  listNotes,
  getNote,
  matching,
  firstMatching,
  countMatching,
  noneMatch,
  notesMachine,
  Pin,
  Remove,
  Search,
  Undo,
  lastDeleted,
  listShared,
  Share,
  Unshare,
  DUPLICATE,
} from './model.ts'

export const notesText = ui.messages('en', {
  en: { notes: 'Notes', count: 'Notes: {count}', title: 'Title', add: 'Add', delete: 'Delete', search: 'Search', duplicate: 'You already have a note with this title' },
  de: { notes: 'Notizen', count: 'Notizen: {count}', title: 'Titel', add: 'Hinzufügen', delete: 'Löschen', search: 'Suche', duplicate: 'Du hast bereits eine Notiz mit diesem Titel' },
})

// The note being added, shown first until the server accepts it.
const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

// The bulk buttons; each note's checkbox joins this form.
const bulk = ui.formRef()

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: home,
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ q: search.q }),
  render: ({ ctx, when, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [notesText.notes]),
      ui.nav({ class: 'flex gap-4 text-sm' }, [
        ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'underline' }, [locale === 'en' ? 'Deutsch' : 'English']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(archive, null), class: 'underline' }, ['Archived notes']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(accountDelete, null), class: 'underline' }, ['Delete account']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, {}), class: 'underline' }, ['Export']),
      ]),
      ui.form({ class: 'flex gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Add, { title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
        ui.label({ for: 'notes-title', class: 'sr-only' }, [notesText.title]),
        ui.input({
          id: 'notes-title',
          name: 'title',
          required: true,
          maxlength: 60,
          placeholder: notesText.title,
          value: ctx.draft,
          'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null,
          'aria-describedby': 'notes-title-error',
          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
          on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
        }),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white' }, [notesText.add]),
      ]),
      ui.p({ id: 'notes-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [ctx.error === DUPLICATE ? notesText.duplicate : ctx.error]),
      ui.query(
        lastDeleted,
        {},
        {
          ready: (deleted) =>
            deleted === null
              ? null
              : ui.div({ role: 'status', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 rounded bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, [
                ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [`Deleted "${deleted.title}"`]),
                ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Undo, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                  ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: deleted.id }),
                  ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, ['Undo']),
                ]),
              ]),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (items) => ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [notesText.count({ count: items.length })]),
            ui.form({ method: 'get', class: 'flex gap-2' }, [
              ui.input({
                type: 'search',
                name: 'q',
                'aria-label': notesText.search,
                placeholder: notesText.search,
                value: ctx.q,
                class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
                on: { input: ui.send(Search, { q: ui.dom.value }) },
              }),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded border px-4 py-2' }, [notesText.search]),
            ]),
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
              `Showing ${matching({ items: firstMatching({ items, q: search.q, limit: search.limit }), q: ctx.q }).length} of ${countMatching({ items, q: search.q })}`,
            ]),
            ui.form({ ref: bulk, 'aria-label': 'Bulk actions', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 text-sm', on: { submit: ui.send(Bulk, { ids: ui.dom.formAll('ids'), action: ui.dom.form('action') }) } }, [
              ui.span({ class: 'flex-1 text-slate-600' }, [`Selected: ${ctx.selected.length}`]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'delete', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, ['Delete selected']),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'archive', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, ['Archive selected']),
            ]),
            noneMatch({ items: firstMatching({ items, q: search.q, limit: search.limit }), q: ctx.q })
              ? [
                when(['adding'], [ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [pendingNote(ctx.draft)])]),
                ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, ['No notes match']),
              ]
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                when(['adding'], [pendingNote(ctx.draft)]),
                ui.each(matching({ items: firstMatching({ items, q: search.q, limit: search.limit }), q: ctx.q }), 'id', (item) =>
                  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                    ui.input({
                      type: 'checkbox',
                      form: bulk,
                      name: 'ids',
                      value: item.id,
                      'aria-label': `Select ${item.title}`,
                      checked: ctx.selected.includes(item.id),
                      on: { change: ui.send(Select, { id: item.id, checked: ui.dom.checked }) },
                    }),
                    ctx.editing === item.id
                      ? ui.form({ class: 'flex flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Save, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.input({
                          name: 'title',
                          'aria-label': 'Edit title',
                          required: true,
                          maxlength: 60,
                          value: item.title,
                          'aria-invalid': ctx.editError !== null,
                          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-2 py-1',
                        }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['Save']),
                        ctx.editError !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'w-full text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.editError === DUPLICATE ? notesText.duplicate : ctx.editError]),
                      ])
                      : ui.a({ href: ui.link(notePage, { number: `${item.number}` }), class: 'flex-1 underline' }, [item.title]),
                    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, [`No. ${item.number}`]),
                    ui.time({ datetime: item.createdAt, class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, [`Added ${addedOn({ at: item.createdAt })}`]),
                    item.pinned && ui.span({ class: 'rounded bg-amber-100 px-2 text-xs text-amber-800' }, ['pinned']),
                    ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Pin, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                      ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                      ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [item.pinned ? 'Unpin' : 'Pin']),
                    ]),
                    ctx.editing === item.id
                      ? ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(CancelEdit, {}) } }, [
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['Cancel']),
                      ])
                      : ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Edit, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['Edit']),
                      ]),
                    ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Remove, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                      ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                      ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [notesText.delete]),
                    ]),
                    ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Archive, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                      ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                      ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['Archive']),
                    ]),
                    ui.each(item.sharedWith, null, (name) =>
                      ui.span({ class: 'flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500' }, [
                        `shared with ${name}`,
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Unshare, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'name', value: name }),
                          ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [`Unshare ${name}`]),
                        ]),
                      ]),
                    ),
                    ui.form({ class: 'flex gap-1', on: { submit: ui.send(Share, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                      ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                      ui.input({ name: 'name', 'aria-label': 'Share with', required: true, maxlength: 20, class: 'w-24 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-sm' }),
                      ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['Share']),
                    ]),
                  ]),
                ),
              ]),
            countMatching({ items, q: search.q }) > search.limit &&
              ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null, { q: search.q, limit: search.limit + 5 }), class: 'inline-block rounded border px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, ['Load more']),
          ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, ['Loading…']),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Signed out']), Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Unavailable']) },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listShared,
        {},
        {
          ready: (shared) =>
            shared.length === 0
              ? null
              : ui.section({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
                ui.h2({ class: 'text-xl font-semibold' }, ['Shared with me']),
                ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  ui.each(shared, 'id', (note) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [note.title]),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, [`from ${note.owner}`]),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ]),
              ]),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const ArchiveBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: archive,
  render: ({ ctx }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [

## 摘要

`change.md` 的第 23 號變更已完成：每則筆記多了一個「內文」(body) 欄位，未封存的筆記頁可以直接修改標題和內文。啟用和停用 JavaScript 兩種模式都實際測過。`npx hozu check` 結果為 0 個錯誤，6 個警告（HZ090）是原本就有的。我曾在 4814 埠啟動正式伺服器做測試，結束前已依 PID 停掉；`npm start` 仍是單一指令，並沿用 `PORT` 環境變數。

### 修改內容
| 檔案 | 變更 |
|---|---|
| `features/notes/model.ts` | 筆記多了 `body` 欄位；新增 `SaveNote` 事件、`updateNote` 儲存動作，以及一個儲存中的狀態 `savingNote` |
| `features/notes/server.ts` | 現有筆記和新增的筆記，內文都是空的。所有檢查都在伺服器上做，同時回報所有不合格的欄位。標題的規則和新增筆記時一樣：去頭尾空白、1–60 字、不能和自己其他筆記同名（不分大小寫，封存的也算）。內文去頭尾空白後最多 1000 字，換行會保留。已封存的筆記拒絕儲存。在原位更新，所以編號、在清單中的位置、釘選和新增日期都不變；儲存成功後 `Undo` 訊息會消失 |
| `features/notes/views.ts` | 筆記頁新增 `Title`／`Body`／`Save` 表單，有 `required` 和 `maxlength` 限制。每則錯誤訊息各自放在一個 `role="alert"` 元素；儲存成功顯示 `role="status"` 的 `Saved`；內文的換行會照樣顯示；封存筆記只顯示內文、不顯示表單 |
| `hozu.lock.json` | 接受了下列變更 |

### 已接受的鎖定檔變更（`now:` 行）
- `idle --SaveNote--> savingNote · target := event.id, noteTitle := event.title, noteBody := event.body, noteTyped := true, noteFields := {"title":null,"body":null}, noteError := null, noteSaved := false · invoke updateNote(...)`
- `savingNote --done updateNote--> idle · noteTyped := false, noteSaved := true`
- `savingNote --failed updateNote.Archived--> idle · noteError := "This note is archived"`
- `savingNote --failed updateNote.Invalid--> idle · noteFields := error.fields`
- `savingNote --failed updateNote.NotFound--> idle · noteError := "This note no longer exists"`
- `savingNote --failed updateNote.Unexpected--> idle · noteError := error.message`
- `access notes.updateNote: 'anyone'`：和既有的 `renameNote` 一致；未登入的人找不到任何筆記，會得到 `NotFound`

### 測試結果
- **兩種錯誤同時出現：** 標題重複加上內文超過 1000 字，兩則訊息會一起顯示；停用 JS 時回應 400。
- **儲存失敗時：** 標題和內文都保留使用者原本輸入的內容。用 `curl` 看過伺服器產生的 HTML，前後空白和換行都還在。
- **儲存成功後：** `<h1>` 換成新標題，內文分行顯示，並出現 `Saved`；回到清單時 `Undo` 已消失；釘選維持不變。
- **已封存的筆記：** 頁面只有內文、沒有表單；直接偽造送出也會被拒絕，顯示 `This note is archived`。
- **標題訊息：** 用 `hozu call` 確認了 `Write a title first` 和 `Use at most 60 characters`。

### 已知限制
- 筆記頁上的文字只有英文，`de` 語系下也一樣。這和現有的筆記頁、清單內的編輯錯誤訊息做法相同。
- 匯出（`/api/export`）還不包含內文，因為變更需求沒有要求。

## 下一步建議
1. **確認匯出範圍：** 決定 `/api/export` 要不要加入內文。這會改變對外的 JSON 格式，最好先通知使用匯出的人。
2. **補德文翻譯：** 把筆記頁的 `Title`、`Body`、`Save`、`Saved` 和各則錯誤訊息加進 `notesText`，提供德文版本。
3. **處理既有警告：** 把 `listNotes`、`listArchived` 等查詢從 `'anyone'` 改成 `access: 'signedIn'`，消除那 6 個 HZ090 警告，也讓存取規則更嚴謹。
